question: What measurement procedure is prescribed for placing one part in front when forming the fire-pit?
premises: One part is to be placed in front.
The placement follows a specific measure.
The measure involves corner and half divisions.
inference: One should place one part in front according to the measure of corner, half, and half.
uncertainties: koṇa-arddha-arddha-pramāṇataḥ is a technical measurement phrase; interpreted as corner and successive half measures.
plain_english: One should place one part in front according to the measure of a corner and half and half.
